lead_raw_text:
The structure of SrFeSe2 crystallizes in the triclinic space group P1, with a unit cell containing four atoms across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis shows Fe centers in octahedral coordination by six Se neighbors, while Sr centers have ten geometric neighbors (six Se, four Sr). Corner-sharing is observed between Fe octahedra, and corner- and edge-sharing occur between Fe octahedra and Sr coordination polyhedra. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
